research_notes: Blocked: private employer and broad job dates established, but full-time hours and precise interval endpoints not found in official, party, public-post or targeted full-time searches using both search engines.
Woolworths pastry and shop-assistant entries overlap and must be merged if later counted. Nearly fifteen years of association with employer is not fifteen documented full-time years.
Need employment confirmation showing casual/part-time/full-time transitions and start/end dates. Tutor volunteering is excluded; missing public history remains unknown.

Follow-up2026-10-02: named AMES Noble Park as volunteering host; primary employer journal confirms SDA Victoria role; contemporary ABC expressly establishes full-time organiser. Part-time retail while studying is evidenced, but no calendar bounds for that status or later changes.

First-speech account broadens worksite history beyond Dandenong Plaza and adds delegate/HSR responsibilities. Study qualifications are not paid teaching. An AMES article about chief of staff Hafiz and his full-time employment concerns another person and is excluded.

Follow-up2026-10-03: targeted searches for Woolworths contract status, pastry apprenticeship/training, store transitions, exact SDA commencement and education-support employment returned only the already recorded broad biographies and Summer2017 organiser observation. A2025 ABC profile restates baking/shelf work and qualifications but supplies no employment boundaries or hours. No retail full-time interval was inferred.

Next leads: Woolworths work-history confirmation with store and contract changes, dated training/apprenticeship records, exact SDA appointment/cessation and AMES volunteer dates. Private FT headline stays null because excluded union FT evidence cannot be transferred to retail.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted pastry-apprenticeship, qualification and Woolworths-training searches found the current official profile's Cert III Commercial Cookery (Box Hill TAFE), Cert IV Patisserie and Diploma of Hospitality Management (William Angliss), alongside the already recorded 2002–2017 shop-assistant and 2008–2017 pastry-chef labels. The qualifications do not establish an apprenticeship employer, training dates, paid study, contract type or full-time hours. Exact retail status transitions, store movements, SDA appointment/cessation and AMES volunteer dates remain unresolved; no headline interval was inferred.
